outlook.statement: The medium- to long-term outlook for the thermoplastics industry remains supported by its wide range of applications across various sectors. The Company intends to focus on: Strengthening its customer base and improving market reach; Improving operational efficiency and cost management; Exploring opportunities in value-added products and new markets; Efficient management of working capital; and Strengthening the overall financial position of the Company

The Company remains focused on reviving its core operating revenues, expanding its customer and product base, improving capacity utilisation and strengthening operational efficiencies. The Company will also continue to pursue cost optimisation, effective working capital management, reduction of debt obligations and appropriate financial restructuring measures, wherever feasible. Going forward, the Management intends to focus on strengthening the Company's core business, improving sustainable operating profitability, maintaining prudent financial discipline and progressively strengthening the Company's financial position.
